secondary_note: Two-sided parent-bootstrap p for 'ON - OFF != 0'; BH q = 0.10 across every listed contrast (28). About half are ledger contrasts expected to be near-certain, which loosens the BH thresholds for register and prerequisite. False-copy and step-level rates condition on arm-specific step sets, so their ON - OFF differences are paired by parent only.

wording.headline: CONFIRMED (strong pass: both one-sided 95% bounds beyond the thresholds)
statement: On 150 fresh ledger parents, adding a LoRA trained on 1,501 oracle-labelled one-step rows stratified toward rule cases (T2 seed 0, the fixed artifact) to frozen Titan-Sparse lowered the normalised regret of its chained four-step self-rollout decisions from 0.544 to 0.056 (ON - OFF -0.488, 95% CI [-0.535, -0.443], one-sided 95% upper bound -0.450, Holm one-sided p 0.0002; 0 = oracle, 1 = random) and raised four-step exact-state accuracy from 0.029 to 0.698 (+0.668, [+0.642, +0.695], one-sided 95% lower bound +0.646), against the same model with the adapter off in the same process. Both point estimates are beyond the pre-set thresholds (-0.15, +0.25); strong pass: yes.

P1 ledger chain_one k=4 normalised regret, ON - OFF: -0.488 (OFF 0.544 -> ON 0.056), 95% CI [-0.535, -0.443], one-sided 95% upper bound -0.450, Holm one-sided p 0.0002; threshold -0.15: PASS (strong).

P2 ledger chain_one k=4 exact-state accuracy, ON - OFF: +0.668 (OFF 0.029 -> ON 0.698), 95% CI [+0.642, +0.695], one-sided 95% lower bound +0.646, Holm one-sided p 0.0002; threshold +0.25: PASS (strong).
wording.guard: Forgetting guard PASS: off-task first-token KL(OFF||ON) is 0.50x KL(Supa||Sparse), the Titan delta's own drift (95% CI 0.34-0.70; one-sided 95% bounds 0.37 / 0.67); cumulative KL(Supa||ON) is 1.94x KL(Supa||Sparse) (reading bound 1.25); 64-token greedy agreement OFF/ON 0.54 vs Supa/Sparse 0.50 vs Supa/ON 0.37. A re-measurement of quantities partly known before the freeze (§5b).
descriptive: Split halves (random, exchangeable; descriptive only): P1 A -0.504 / B -0.473; P2 A +0.657 / B +0.680
limits: Ledger only, horizon <= 4, one adapter (T2 seed 0), Titan-Sparse only, the chain_one frame.
The plans and the adapter's training rows come from the same event generator and marginals: the bank is fresh at payload level, not out-of-distribution.

Rule learning is not separated from frame adaptation (no self-distillation or untargeted-LoRA control); posted-arithmetic gains count toward the effect, and the targeting of the training rows was not shown to cause the gain.

No comparison with non-LM learners at the same label budget: S@abundant (4,000 parents) reached 0.273 on ledger in PREREG-1 and S-roll matched Titan on ledger at about 512 transitions (R10); the adapted model used 384 + 1,501 oracle-labelled rows.
Register (mix, wrap) and prerequisite are not claimed fixed; the prerequisite prediction is a copy shortcut, and the prerequisite family is fresh at payload level only.
Retention evidence is limited to the first-token guard and 64-token agreement on 248 prompts, a re-measurement of quantities partly known before the freeze (§5b).
